What Are Camlock Couplings?
Camlock couplings, also known as cam and groove couplings, are quick-connect fittings designed for fast and secure hose connections in fluid and gas transfer applications. The design of SAE flanges is based on a four-bolt connection system that ensures uniform load distribution and superior sealing capability. This design minimizes the chances of leakage and enhances the overall reliability of the system. It is divided into different parts, with ISO 6162-1 covering Code 61 flanges for medium-pressure applications and ISO 6162-2 covering Code 62 flanges for high-pressure applications. This standard defines critical parameters such as dimensions, bolt patterns, pressure ratings, and sealing methods, ensuring consistency and interchangeability across global markets. It categorizes flanges into Code 61 and Code 62, similar to ISO 6162, ensuring compatibility between the two standards. SAE J518 is widely adopted in industries that require high-performance hydraulic systems, particularly in North America and other global markets. The standard ensures that flange connections deliver reliable sealing, structural strength, and durability under extreme working conditions, making it a trusted specification for engineers and manufacturers.
